gloss: to fit into; to get stuck; to become addicted

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {嵌|は}まっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to fit into; to go into
definitions.explanation: For something to fit precisely into a space or opening.

definitions.gloss: to get stuck; to fall into
definitions.explanation: To fall into a trap, hole, or difficult situation.

definitions.gloss: to be addicted; to be into
definitions.explanation: To become deeply absorbed in a hobby or activity.

notes:
{嵌|は}まる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) with both literal and figurative meanings.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{嵌|は}める→嵌める：04255_hameru⟧ (to fit, to trap)
- {嵌|は}まる: The piece fits.
- ⟦{嵌|は}める→嵌める：04255_hameru⟧: I fit the piece in.

ASPECT (ている):
{嵌|は}まっている indicates a state of being stuck, fitted, or addicted.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[space]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる — [thing] fits into [space]
- [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[trap]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる — [person] falls into [trap]
- [person]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[hobby]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる — [person] is into [hobby]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{穴|あな}→穴：01691_ana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる (fall into a hole)
- ⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる (fall into a trap)
- ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる (be hooked on a drama)
- ⟦ツボ→ツボ：28424_tsubo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まる (hit the spot, be exactly right)

COLLOQUIAL:
{嵌|は}まる is very common in casual speech for being absorbed in hobbies: ⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}まっている (I'm really into games).
